newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - FEBRUARY 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - FEBRUARY 13.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Shadow Chancellor Gordon Brown has promised that on gaining power Labour would spend at least 3 billion pounds stg in order to put more than half a million people back to work. The money would come from the planned windfall tax.
Gordon Brown has confirmed that a Labour adminstration would introduce a full Budget within weeks of winning a General Election.
TOP MAN WANTED TO SHAKE UP CHANNEL 3
Headhunters are approaching suitable candidates for the position of chief executive for Channel 3 on behalf of the Independent Television Commission. A massive shake-up of the channel is anticipated.
Following complaints from Lloyds investors, major reforms in the way Lloyd's of London provides investment opportunities in its insurance market are under discussion.
'FUNNY MONEY' THAT IS GAINING NEW CURRENCY
Over the past year trading in second tier foreign currencies such as Czech koruna and Thai baht has been booming.
According to a new survey by Weatherall Green and Smith, current demand for central London commercial property has been soaring at a level not since 1989.
